name: No Man's Land
source:
The story unfolds with a man undergoing a year-long cryogenic therapy for a severe haematological illness. Years later he is awaken to a desolate and hollow shell of the world he remembered, overrun by the dead and monstrous entities. He is left to fester in the choices between the primal urge to survive and the daunting task of searching for his family, whose fate remains unknown.

As he navigates through the ruins of civilization, he discovers a chilling reality: men have become an endangered species, making him one of the last males still kicking in this dystopian nightmare. Within this no man's land lies horrors that want to prey on him and eat him; but perhaps it is those who want him alive that should terrify him.

[From [url=https://duck-x.itch.io/no-mans-land]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一名男子因严重血液疾病接受长达一年的低温治疗。多年后，他醒来，发现他记忆中的世界是一个荒凉而空洞的外壳，被死亡和可怕的实体所占领。他只能在求生的原始冲动和寻找家人的艰巨任务之间做出选择，而家人的命运仍然未知。

当他穿越文明废墟时，他发现了一个令人毛骨悚然的现实：人类已成为濒临灭绝的物种，使他成为仍在这个反乌托邦噩梦中挣扎的最后男性之一。在这无人区里，存在着想要捕食他并吃掉他的恐怖者；但也许那些想要他活着的人应该吓唬他。

[来自[url=https://duck-x.itch.io/no-mans-land]Itch.io[/url]]
